notes: RETRIEVAL CAVEAT: sciencedirect.com/journal/brain-stimulation/publish/guide-for-authors, its elsevier.com redirect target, and the journal's own brainstimjrnl.com domain (both the guide-for-authors deep link and the homepage) all returned HTTP 403 to every WebFetch attempt in this session.

This is the SPARSEST profile in this batch. Only the citation-style family (Vancouver numbered / elsarticle-num, ICMJE-aligned), the 250-word structured-abstract requirement, and the 300dpi TIFF/JPG/PNG photograph spec were corroborated with enough independent, consistent phrasing to record as documented. Everything else a full Elsevier Guide for Authors normally states — word limits per article type, reference-list entry template, figure column widths, line weights, required-section list, spacing/line-number policy, author-truncation threshold — returned either nothing or single, unconfirmed, inconsistently-worded search results and is left null per the no-invention rule rather than filled in from Elsevier's generic house template or a sibling neuromodulation/Elsevier journal (e.g. Deep Brain Stimulation, Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation), which would violate the no-sibling-inference rule.
Treat this profile as a skeleton requiring direct (browser-based) re-verification of the live guide-for-authors page before the word/reference/figure limits can be trusted for compliance checking.
